Subject: Post-discovery: request for 3 short windows for 30m product intro and tech attendee

Hi Amit / Jenna —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call:
- Pain: inconsistent latency at scale + rising per-token inference cost across your RAG pipelines.
- Goal: evaluate a path to predictable latency and lower unit costs without re-architecting the stack.
- Success metric: proof of a 2x reduction in tail latency and ~30% token cost improvement within a pilot workload.

Next step: schedule a 30-minute product intro where we’ll run a short demo and surface the deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) — Ben (solutions) and Maya (pricing/ops) will join for the technical and cost discussion.

Can you confirm who from Novata should attend (product, infra, security)? If Claire from security should join we’ll include her in the invite. Below are three compact windows we can offer — two consecutive early-week times plus a late-week fallback. Pick one and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Option A — Wed, Aug 11 — 09:00–09:30 PT (good for EMEA overlap)
Option B — Thu, Aug 12 — 11:00–11:30 PT (best for product + infra)
Option C — Fri, Aug 13 — 08:30–09:00 PT (earlier slot if you prefer a short end-of-week)

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf (brief overview + sample latency profile).

If none of these work, tell me two windows that do and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
